title: Random Respawns Ported
description: Respawns you in a random location every death, highly configurable.
body:
## Random Respawns (Forge 1.20.1)

![RandomRespawns](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7e584901fe38e213d888d549282fcd41395ac45b.png)

## About

This mod adds a highly configurable ways to respawn randomly through your minecraft world.

The following things can be configured:

-Avoid Hazards on Respawn: Avoids hazards like Lava or Powder snow on Respawn

-Avoid Oceans: Will avoid ocean biomes when Respawning

-Death position is Origin: When true, respawn will occur with respect to your death position, rather than the world origin

-Enable Random Respawns: Enables Random Respawns

-Random Respawn Radius: Radius within which respawn occurs

-Set time to Zero on Death: Set time to 0 on death

-Set Weather Clear on Respawn: Sets weather to clear on respawn

## Important Notes:

-This mod requieres Forge Config Screens to configurate the mod

-This mod is server side only
